name: Hollow
source:
Stuck between the veil of life & death, Gabe has searched for the answers surrounding his untimely passing. After crossing paths with Nix, the first person he's been able to communicate with, can he learn the secrets of his past and finally find a way to crossover?

[From [url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/hollow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被困在生与死的面纱之间，加布一直在寻找有关他英年早逝的答案。在与他第一个能够交流的人尼克斯相遇后，他能否了解自己过去的秘密并最终找到穿越的方法？

[来自[url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/hollow]Itch.io[/url]]
